transcript.text: Hello, welcome to the On Print Shop Store personalization tutorial series.
In today's video we will walk you through the steps to manage the sidebar and sidebar widgets in your front store.
The sidebar of your site is a great place to add information and anything else you want your visitors to have easy access to no matter what page they land on.
On the storefront, you can see that there is no sidebar on the left hand side or on the right hand side as of now.
So how do you activate that for the customers?
For this, let's go to the admin panel, navigate to the Store Personalization section, and then click on the Sidebar management.
On this page you can find some sections listed that can be displayed in the sidebar.
You can select to activate these sections either for the right sidebar or the left sidebar by selecting Yes from the drop down menu from the sections.
The first one is the default, which allows you to activate the default sections to be displayed in the sidebar when no other sections listed below are activated.
Let's activate the side for the Browse Design page to check how this works.
To activate the left sidebar, click on the Yes from here, or if you want to activate the sidebar on the right side, click on the Yes from here and then click on Save.
Now let's verify that in the front store, select any product from the menu and then from the Product Details page, click on the Browse Design button.
On the Product Designs page, you can now see that the customer login widget is there on the left side, and the Subscribe Here and Testimonials widgets are displayed on the right side of the page.
Let's deactivate the left sidebar for the browse page.
Then let's go back to the admin panel.
From the left sidebar column, select No from the drop down and then save the changes on the front store.
Refresh the page.
As you can see, the Customer Login widget is now not here.

Moving back to the admin panel on the Browse design page, if you want to hide any specific section such as testimonials from the right sidebar, then click on this edit icon and you will get the lists of sections to hide.
Select the Testimonials checkbox and then save and from the main screen click on the Save button from the top right corner.
In the video, we have been talking about widgets and how you can manage those widgets for the sidebar.
For this, let's click on the sidebar widget menu from the left navigation panel.
This is the screen where you will find all the widgets or the sections that can be displayed in the sidebar.
Please note that there is no option for you to add any new widget to the list or remove the listed widgets.
You will only get the option to edit them or manage their status.
So these are the sections that you can display in the sidebar.
Such as product category is set to be displayed in the left sidebar and it is positioned to be displayed always.
To change these settings, click on the edit icon.
On the next screen, you can change the title for the widget, change the position from left to right or vice versa.
You can choose to display this as always before customer login, after customer login, or only on the user's account pages.
You can make the necessary changes and then click on the save and back button.
Similarly, you can manage the other widgets to be displayed in the sidebar.
And that's it.
This is how you can manage the sidebar and widgets for your front store.
If you have any questions, our support executives are here to help.
Just reach out through live chat on on printshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
